# WEKA

> WEKA is an AI storage company building the NeuralMesh ecosystem — a high-performance, software-defined data platform purpose-built for accelerated compute and agentic AI infrastructure. NeuralMesh combines GPU-native storage, augmented memory, and turnkey appliances to help organizations eliminate data bottlenecks, maximize GPU utilization, and scale AI workloads from training to inference.

## Products

- [NeuralMesh](https://www.weka.io/product/neuralmesh/): High-performance, container-native storage system purpose-built for AI training, inference, and data-intensive workloads at scale
- [NeuralMesh Axon](https://www.weka.io/product/neuralmesh-axon/): GPU-native AI storage delivering ultra-low latency and high throughput directly to accelerated compute
- [WEKApod](https://www.weka.io/product/wekapod/): Turnkey data platform appliance designed for NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD with pre-configured storage and software for rapid deployment
- [Augmented Memory Grid](https://www.weka.io/product/augmented-memory-grid/): Extends GPU memory up to 1000x, unlocking larger models and longer context windows without additional hardware
- [NeuralMesh AIDP](https://www.weka.io/product/neuralmesh-aidp/): Integrated AI data platform combining storage, memory, and orchestration for full AI factory workflows
- [NeuralMesh Capabilities](https://www.weka.io/product/capabilities/): Full technical capability overview including POSIX, NFS, S3, SMB, GPUDirect Storage, snapshots, tiering, and encryption

## Deployment Options

- [AI Data Center](https://www.weka.io/product/ai-data-center/): On-premises NeuralMesh deployment for private AI data centers and GPU clusters
- [Public Cloud](https://www.weka.io/product/public-cloud/): NeuralMesh on AWS, Azure, and GCP for cloud-native AI workloads
- [Hybrid Cloud](https://www.weka.io/product/hybrid-cloud-storage/): Unified storage spanning on-premises and cloud environments with a single namespace
- [AI Cloud Providers](https://www.weka.io/product/ai-cloud-providers/): Purpose-built storage infrastructure for GPU cloud and neocloud providers

- [AI Factory](https://www.weka.io/solutions/ai-factory/): End-to-end AI factory infrastructure from data ingestion and training to inference and production delivery
- [AI Inference Acceleration](https://www.weka.io/solutions/ai-inference-acceleration/): Low-latency storage optimized for real-time AI inference and agentic workloads
- [Generative AI](https://www.weka.io/solutions/weka-for-generative-ai/): Storage infrastructure for training and serving large language models and foundation models
- [Reduce AI Token Costs](https://www.weka.io/solutions/reduce-ai-token-costs/): Architectural approach to increasing token efficiency and cutting AI infrastructure costs
- [GPU Acceleration](https://www.weka.io/solutions/gpu-acceleration/): Maximize GPU utilization by eliminating storage bottlenecks in accelerated compute environments
- [High-Performance Computing](https://www.weka.io/solutions/hpc-data-management/): All-flash parallel file system performance for HPC workloads without complexity tradeoffs
- [High-Performance Data Analytics](https://www.weka.io/solutions/high-performance-data-analytics/): Fast data pipelines for analytics at data warehouse performance on all-flash infrastructure

- [Containerized Workloads](https://www.weka.io/solutions/containerized-applications/): High-performance persistent storage for Kubernetes and containerized AI workloads
- [Cloud Service Providers](https://www.weka.io/solutions/specialized-cloud-services/): Scalable AI storage infrastructure for GPU clouds and cloud service providers
